analysis.summary: DAFuzz fuzzes in-memory data stores such as Redis, whose commands operate on typed data structures. Feeding a command arguments of the wrong type gets it rejected immediately, so DAFuzz tracks the types of live data and generates commands whose arguments match, reaching code that type-blind fuzzing does not.
